diagnosis.problem: SSH keys from POLARIS are not authorized on ANY gate except eastGate Pi (via WireGuard only). The id_ed25519_vps key was likely rotated on the Pi at some point and POLARIS was never updated, or the Pi changed its authorized_keys.
diagnosis.root_cause: Key rotation or authorized_keys change on eastGate Pi. sporeGate trusts eastGate's key but not POLARIS's key. northGate (POLARIS) was rebuilt or re-provisioned and never had its new key distributed.
diagnosis.solution_amoeba: Deploy AMOEBA (RustDesk) on eastGate Pi first (it already runs hbbs/hbbr, just need the client). Pi can then SSH to sporeGate (WG mesh LIVE). Install AMOEBA on sporeGate FROM the Pi. Then we can see into sporeGate via RustDesk.
diagnosis.solution_ssh: Alternative: Copy POLARIS's id_ed25519_vps.pub to the Pi via the web interface or via the hbbs/hbbr that's already running, then SSH in normally.

critical_discovery.sporeGate_is: The build foreman that compiles and signs all primals. It has the primals AMOEBA needs most (swarmVine + songBird + bearDog). It IS the nervous system hub.
critical_discovery.wg_mesh_live: sporeGate ↔ eastGate WireGuard is LIVE. eastGate can reach sporeGate via WG even if POLARIS can't SSH directly.
critical_discovery.path_in: POLARIS → RustDesk → Pi relay → Pi SSH → sporeGate (via WG 192.168.4.3)
